card.title: Same Memory, Different Meaning
card.instruction: Return to one shared memory as comfort, then evidence, then accusation, changing its meaning without abandoning the facts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when you saved me the window seat? I thought I mattered to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knew you liked the view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Proof that you noticed small things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Also, the seat beside it had less legroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So my fondest memory of being understood was your knees negotiating space.

mechanism: A changes a shared seat memory from comfort to proof of care to an accusation of self-interest.
confusable: Unlike revising historical facts, A must preserve the seating event while changing what motive it signifies.
comparison: S223-a concerns physical seating motives; S223-b concerns a displayed early painting and social reassurance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
